en.topic_title: 3 ex-HSBC staff face anti-corruption watchdog charges over alleged bribes for bank account openings
en.topic_summary:
Three former HSBC staff have been charged over allegedly accepting bribes to assist customers in opening bank accounts without joining the queue. Each customer was referred by an insurance agent.



HSBC. File Photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP.



Chan Fu-kwan, 32; Mike Chan, 29; and Bernie Yau, 33, were relationship managers at an HSBC Causeway Bay branch at the time of the offences in 2024, according to a Thursday press release from the Independent Commission Against Corruption.
